summary.what_it_is: A collection of 25 production-grade engineering skills for AI coding agents that encode senior engineer workflows, quality gates, and best practices across the development lifecycle. It provides 9 slash commands (spec, plan, build, test, review, etc.) that map to development phases and work with 70+ AI agents including Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, and Copilot.
summary.why_trending: Growing interest in AI coding agents and the need for standardized, production-ready engineering practices that can be shared across different AI tools. The project offers a simple CLI (npx skills add) to install skills into multiple agents at once.
summary.who_its_for: Developers using AI coding assistants who want consistent, senior-level engineering workflows automated in their development process.
